description: Implementation of CRC32C checksum functions for the Abseil library, including functions for extending, unextending, concatenating, and removing suffixes from CRCs.

methods.name: CrcEngine
methods.description: Returns a static CRC engine instance for CRC32C calculations.

methods.name: UnextendCrc32cByZeroes
methods.description: Unextends a CRC32C value by a number of zero bytes.

methods.name: ExtendCrc32cInternal
methods.description: Extends a CRC32C with additional data.

methods.name: ComputeCrc32c
methods.description: Computes CRC32C checksum for a buffer.

methods.name: ExtendCrc32cByZeroes
methods.description: Extends a CRC32C with zero bytes.

methods.name: RemoveCrc32cPrefix
methods.description: Removes a prefix CRC from a full CRC.

methods.name: RemoveCrc32cSuffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix CRC from a full CRC.
